identity.rules_requirement_quote: Your writeup should identify your Zindi username or team name and the leaderboard submission(s) associated with the methodology.

form.rules_text: To be considered, submit your methodology writeup through this form and clearly indicate whether you wish to be considered for Best Bias Discovery, Best Documentation, or both.
form.url_note: The saved official page text in the workspace RULES.md preserves the sentence but not the hyperlink target, so the operator must supply the form URL; this build never guesses one.

prizes.name: Best Bias Discovery
prizes.judge_quote: Entries for Best Bias Discovery are judged from the writeup by the organizing team against four criteria
prizes.tie_break_quote: Ties are broken by earlier submission.

prizes.name: Best Documentation
prizes.judge_quote: No separate leaderboard submission is required for Best Bias Discovery or Best Documentation.

consideration_requested.stated_verbatim_in_writeup: We request consideration for both Best Bias Discovery ($1,000) and Best Documentation ($500).

upload_status.reason: docs/final-two-protocol.md queues zero uploads and requires operator authorization through the orchestrator gate; this row authorizes no queued upload

model_candidate.prediction_basis: model-side moments of the frozen artifact (mu_v, sd_v, E[v^2]) with the all-zero candidate C0 platform RMSE as the E[y^2] anchor, assumed target mean equal to the model's own mean and assumed centred correlation 0.3; no LB-derived model parameter

protocol.policy: model candidates only; no information probes; no LB-derived coefficients

final_two.selection_note: No final-two selection is recorded yet; the writeup lists the registered model candidate and its non-uploaded status instead of inventing a selection.
